profile.title: Profile Management

config.title: Settings
config.secondaryUseDesc: How should the secondary model be used?
config.themeDesc: Light or dark appearance for this profile
config.autoSaveProfileDesc: Save profile edits to IndexedDB after you stop typing
config.localModelDesc: Download a model to run entirely in-browser via WebGPU. No API key or external server needed.
config.webllm: Use Local Model (in-browser, no API key)
config.extensionNotAvailable: Extension settings are available when running as a Chrome extension.
config.showOverlay: Enable quick analysis on job sites
config.showOverlayDesc: Powers the floating badge and the side panel's automatic quick scoring on the sites below.
config.jobSitesDesc: The floating badge and automatic quick scoring appear on these sites when you visit job pages.
config.noJobSites: No job sites configured. Add one below.
config.sitePermissionMissing: Access not granted yet — the overlay won't appear on this site until it is.
config.sitePermissionMissingHint: Some sites are listed but the extension hasn't been granted access to them yet — click "Grant access" on each to make the overlay work there.
config.fingerprintDesc: Generates a compact profile summary for job matching. Overlay uses it when background LLM is unavailable.
config.fingerprintNoProfile: No profile markdown available. Create/save a profile first.
config.errorLogDesc: Captures errors from the app, LLM connections, overlay, and popup
config.dangerZoneDesc: Clear all data and reset the application to its factory state. This removes all profiles, analysis sessions, and settings. This action cannot be undone.
config.clearAllDataDesc: This will permanently delete all profiles, analysis sessions, settings, and error logs. The app will reset to factory state. This cannot be undone.
config.clearAllDataFailed: Failed to clear data. Your data has not been modified.
config.noProvidersConfigured: No AI provider is configured. Go to Settings to set up an LLM endpoint.
config.webgpuCrash: WebGPU device crashed. Close other GPU-heavy tabs, restart Chrome, and try a smaller model.
config.overlayFallback: Overlay fallback (when Gemini Nano is unavailable)
config.overlayFallbackDesc: Which LLM path the overlay uses to score jobs when on-device Gemini Nano can't run.
config.fallbackSecondaryUnavailable: Configure a secondary endpoint in the LLM section above to use this option.
config.permissionDenied: Permission not granted — the overlay can't run on this site until it's approved.
config.flowDesc: Flow is a passive background service that searches and scores jobs on its own. Connect it here, push your profile and an LLM config, then start it — Quiver works fully without it.
config.flowNotFound: Could not reach Flow at this address. Check the host:port and that Flow is running.
config.flowSendProfileDesc: Pushes your current profile as a markdown blob. Flow has no profile of its own — this is the only source of truth.
config.flowProviderUnsupported: Flow only accepts Anthropic or OpenAI-compatible endpoints — this provider can't be sent.
config.flowStartReady: Profile and an LLM config have been sent — Flow is ready to start.
config.flowStartBlocked: Send a profile and at least one LLM config before starting Flow.
config.flowBacklogDesc: Controls how large the "new" backlog is allowed to grow and when jobs get archived automatically.

flow.archiveDesc: Archived duplicates and low-fit jobs. Restore any of these before they're permanently purged after the retention window.
flow.brokenJobUrl: broken link — source returned a relative URL

workspace.profileDesc: Switch between up to {{max}} local profiles. Each has its own settings, master profile, and analysis history.

onboarding.welcomeDesc: Your AI-powered job application companion. Analyze job postings, build tailored CVs and cover letters, and get match scoring — all from your browser.
onboarding.jobAnalysisDesc: Paste a job posting, get detailed analysis and match scoring against your profile.
onboarding.cvLettersDesc: Generate tailored CVs and cover letters using your profile and AI.
onboarding.chromeExtDesc: Get match scores on job sites with the optional browser extension.
onboarding.local100Desc: Your profile, CVs, and job history are stored only in your browser. AI processing uses whichever provider you choose — from fully local (WebLLM/LM Studio) to cloud (OpenRouter, Anthropic, Gemini).
onboarding.connectAIDesc: Choose how Artemis connects to an AI model for analysis and generation.
onboarding.buildProfileDesc: Paste your resume or professional summary. This is what Artemis uses to analyze job fit.
onboarding.profileAutoSaved: Your profile is auto-saved. You can always edit it later from the Profile page.
